crossRefs.keyword: lest they exalt themselves. or, let them not be exalted

translations.web: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud.
translations.bsb: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
translations.kjv: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
translations.asv: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, lest they exalt themselves. Selah
